result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: automatic renewals are limited to 12 months, Customer can prevent renewal on 30 days’ written notice, IBM must provide a 60-day renewal reminder, and renewal increases are capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%. The changes are confined to the playbook requirements and preserve the reciprocal non-renewal right. Drafting is professional, though the CPI provision could be more precise by identifying the applicable CPI index, measurement dates, and treatment of a negative CPI.
